source: Apple Newsroom English; all retrievable articles with usable body in 2023-2025
target: 1[raw Close(D+1)>raw Close(D)] on consecutive actual exchange sessions
date_only_news_policy: use earliest actual market session strictly after publication date
split_policy: purge samples whose target_date crosses its split end
sentiment_input: title or title plus every extracted body paragraph; nonoverlapping 510-token chunks with token-weighted pooling
parameter_selection: fixed before inference; no validation/test parameter search
primary_metric: paired accuracy difference on test; Holm-corrected paired sign permutation p-values
limitations: historical body revisions not independently archived
no independent human extraction gold set yet
